purpose: SHAPE-STRESS only. Not real-trade accuracy, not a trained parameter, not a promotion.
winTolerance: within 1% of the larger evaluated package = even

stress.definition: Each case: |A|,|B| ~ U{1..4}, values ~ U{500..9999}; add ~ U{1..3000}; raise ~ U{1..2000} on one random B asset; scale factor alternates 0.5 / 2. gap = adjusted A - adjusted B. Failures: adding to A lowers gap; adding to B raises gap; raising a B asset raises gap; swap does not negate; reversing order changes gap; scaled gap != k*gap; 1v1 gap != raw gap. Integer-rounded outputs (KTC, dispatch) get 1 point of slack.
